name: Portfolio - Project 02 Operations State Engine
description: Self-contained live backend for the Monday.com Project Operations Control Center portfolio reconstruction. No Monday.com account is required. Provides persistent demo state, task integrity, append-only work sessions, revisions/rework, timesheets, effective-dated labor rates, locked approved ledger posting, escalation control, KPI recalculation, audit logging, idempotency, and reconciliation.
